notes.title: Prelude for a Dream has a new price
notes.content:
Great news: Prelude for a Dream has a new price. Check the individual price for your country.

It is important to remember that it is at the lowest possible price. So if you want to buy Prelude for a Dream, you have been with it for a long time on the wishlist etc. The time to buy is now.

Enjoy Prelude for a Dream.

notes.title: A second important announcement:
notes.content:
Due to many suggestions, and to make the game more accessible. It is being introduced a mechanism called: ''Wild Oasis''. That works as follows- Stand in front of the ''Wild Oasis'' and hit the command button (example: like to talk to a character). ''Wild Oasis'' will give you directions on the World Map. I hope this will make it easier to explore.

In addition, the battles in World Map were considerably reduced. The bosses also have a reasonable buff. In addition, there are new NPCs.

I hope that these changes bring about an increase in the Prelude for a Dream experience. Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: Prelude for a Dream has now Achievements!
notes.content:
Important announcement- Prelude for a Dream has now Achievements. To celebrate this, the game will be 70% off. Starting 03/30/2018 10:00

Try to get them all! Good luck in your journey!
